sentences.text: Grant of Token Amount for Construction of House for the Construction Workers

**Scheme Brief Description:** The "Grant of Token Amount for Construction of House for the Construction Workers'' by the BOCW Welfare Board, Labour Department, U.T. Administration of DNH & DD, is a welfare scheme that provides financial assistance to the eligible registered member for construction of house.
**Who is this for:** Individual; Category: Social welfare & Empowerment; Sector: Financial assistance
**Where it applies:** Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu; State/ UT

**Detailed Description:** The &quot;Grant of Token Amount for Construction of House for the Construction Workers&quot; by the Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board, Labour Department, U.T. Administration of Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu, is a welfare scheme for the registered workers of the board. Under this scheme, registered beneficiaries of the board shall be provided with financial assistance for construction of house in their own land.

**Benefits / Assistance:** - **Token Amount:** ₹75,000/-. - **For applicants covered under Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojna (Gramin):** ₹28,000/-.- **For applicants covered under Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojna (Urban):** 1. **For Affordable Housing in Partnership (AHP):** ₹1,30,000/-.1. **For Beneficiary Led Construction (BLC):** ₹50,000/-.

**Application Process:** > **Registration Process as a Building/ Construction Worker:** **Step 1:** Application for registration is to be made in the prescribed form and is to be accompanied by prescribed documents and a fee of not more than ₹50/-. **Step 2:** Application for registration has to be made to the officer authorized by the Board on this behalf. > **Application Process of the Welfare Scheme:** **Step 1:** Any registered worker can make an application in the prescribed [Form-IV](https://www.daman.nic.in/websites/Printing-press-Daman/documents/2020/Extraordinary/Extra%20Ordinary%20No.%2029.pdf) (Refer Page No: 9) along with the mandatory documents (self attested, if required). **Step 2:** Application shall be submitted to the Member Secretary (BOCWWB) for this benefit. > **Check Beneficiary Details:** Visit the [official website](https://bocwddd.in/welfare-schemes/dnh/construction-of-residential-house) and enter the “BOCW Registration No.” of the concerned beneficiary in the Search box. **Helpdesk:** BOCW Department: EMAIL ID: labour-dnh@nic.in PHONE NUMBER : 0260 - 2642374 ADDRESS: Old Circuit House Building, Opposite Bal Bhawan, Silvassa, Dadra and Nagar Haveli Pin:- 396230
**Contacts & Authorities:** Nodal Department: Labour & Employment Department
**Tags:** Labour, Construction Of House, Construction Workers, Building Workers
